name: Ellen Tamaki
bio: Ellen Tamaki (born July 5, 1992) is an American actress who is best known for playing Niko Hamada in Charmed (2018–19), Drea Mikami in Manifest and Patrice in The Housemaid (2025).
place: The Bronx, New York, United States

credits.title: The Housemaid
credits.overview: Trying to escape her past, Millie Calloway accepts a job as a live-in housemaid for the wealthy Nina and Andrew Winchester. But what begins as a dream job quickly unravels into something far more dangerous—a sexy, seductive game of secrets, scandal, and power.

credits.title: Fernanda
credits.overview: An angry Latinx dyke in her twenties wants to make the world a better place, but can barely keep her own life together. Fernanda and her friends deconstruct their lives, fuck them up, and then continue to deconstruct them.

credits.title: Inez & Doug & Kira
credits.overview: When a bipolar woman commits suicide, her sister and her sister's fiancé become entangled in an attempt to discover what pushed her to the brink.

credits.title: We Only Know So Much
credits.overview: A married woman has an affair with a suicidal lover while caring for her husband's sick relatives.

credits.title: Valentina
credits.overview: During the hottest day ever recorded in human history, a fastidious maid’s duties are interrupted when her vagina comes to life. What starts as a simple cry for air turns into an intervention as Valentina’s vagina asks for higher wages and demands better working conditions.

credits.title: The Holdouts
credits.overview: A comedy about New Yorkers who can’t afford to live in New York anymore

credits.title: The Drowning
credits.overview: A psychiatrist faces his past, present and future when he finds himself involved in the treatment of a young man recently released from prison for a murder committed when the boy was just 11 years old.
